in_sanskrit.name: Sharvilaksha
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Goddess Lakshmi's Grace
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Sharvilaksha एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Sharva is a name of Lord Shiva and Lakshmi is the goddess of wealth and prosperity. The name Sharvilaksha signifies the grace of Goddess Lakshmi upon one who is dedicated to Lord Shiva.
